ValidationRule.description: Prevents that any user other than team members of Master data and System Administrator edit the field value
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Sales User")), NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Service User")), ISCHANGED(Industry), ISPICKVAL($User.UserType, "Standard"), OR( ISPICKVAL(BillingCountryCode , "BR"), ISPICKVAL(BillingCountryCode , "PY") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shipping Conditions - Only Master Data or System Administrator team members can edit this field
